column1: # The launcher's installers (bin/site.sh puts them in the page's APPS, and in credits.html with their licences):
# public installers that pass the WD sweep. The page fetches each from installers/FILE beside it; when that is
# missing the guest's agent downloads it from url. id, name, category, bytes, url, file, install (a cmd line in
# the Downloads folder: the sweep's silent install; a tile runs the installer itself, its UI up to the user),
# launch (a cmd line), title (the window's title, a regex), check (installed when it exists), licence (SPDX, or
# the vendor's freeware terms), source (the upstream source of that release), sha256 (bin/installers.sh checks
# each download against it), icon (a program or .msi inside the installer whose icon is the tile's, tools/icons.py; empty:
# args: what a tile passes its installer (an .msi's, after msiexec /i FILE), as a visitor's shortcut might: only
# defaults the visitor still sees and can change in the installer's UI, never a silent switch.
# homepage: a tile whose installer the visitor brings (no url, file or sha256: the site ships none of it); the
# tile links the vendor's site and takes the dropped installer, any version (check may have * in a folder name).
# firefox: Firefox 153.7.0esr (tag FIREFOX_153_7_0esr_RELEASE), built with gexcc from
# @ 4c1e2ccad5 (on the imported tarball, fae40fd3df), packed by Mozilla's own NSIS installer (Nightly branding). Its source stays empty (credits.html: "not published") until
# that patched tree is published: the MPL wants the modified source available beside the binary before a public build.
